title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Pseudocode produces out-of-bounds channel numbers
description: Line 84-85: The pseudocode uses N = MAX(NChannels, 3) then 1 + (Hash MOD N), producing channels 1..N. But valid data channels are 1..(NChannels-1) since CH0 is reserved. When NChannels=8, pseudocode yields channels 1-8, but channel 8 does not exist (channels are 0-7). The note at lines 127-129 confirms implementations must use NChannels - 1 instead, which the pseudocode does not reflect. Any implementation following the pseudocode will fail test vectors and potentially attempt to use non-existent channels.
close_reason: Fixed: Updated pseudocode in appendix-ccp12-hopping.md to use NChannels-1 instead of NChannels for channel selection, matching the correct implementation. Changed both SelectChannel and SynchronizedHopChannel pseudocode, updated examples to show correct result (channel 2 not 5), and removed the discrepancy note since pseudocode now matches test vectors.
